name: resend-button
title: Resend button
description: A Resend code button with a cooldown: a live countdown while waiting, sending and sent states, and an attempt limit that says what to do next.
docs: onResend returns a promise; a rejection shows its message and does not start the timer. maxAttempts counts resends made with this button, and startCooling begins in the waiting state right after the first send. The countdown is announced only at the start, at 10 seconds and at 0, and the button's name stays "Resend code" (labels.ready) while it waits, so a screen reader is not told the time every second.
